<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Proposal C - Home Elevated</title>
<style>
  * {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  }

  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: #E8EEF5;
    font-family: -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif;
  }

  .iphone-frame {
    width: 393px;
    height: 852px;
    border-radius: 47px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1a1a1a, 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    background: #FAFBFD;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .dynamic-island {
    width: 126px;
    height: 37px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 20px;
    position: absolute;
    top: 11px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 10;
  }

  .status-bar {
    height: 54px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 28px 6px 28px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 5;
  }

  .status-bar .time {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #2D3748;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  .status-bar .icons {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .screen-content {
    height: calc(852px - 54px - 83px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0 20px;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }

  .screen-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  /* Date header */
  .date-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 0 10px 0;
  }

  .date-header .date-text {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #2D3748;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  .date-header .date-sub {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .date-divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #C75B2A, #E07B4F, transparent);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    opacity: 0.4;
  }

  /* Section cards */
  .section-card {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(43,94,167,0.06), 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(43,94,167,0.04);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .section-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 4px;
    border-radius: 14px 0 0 14px;
  }

  .section-card.warm::before {
    background: #C75B2A;
  }

  .section-card.warm-light::before {
    background: #E07B4F;
  }

  .section-card.blue::before {
    background: #2B5EA7;
  }

  .section-card.neutral::before {
    background: #C4C9D4;
  }

  /* Stamp separator */
  .stamp-separator {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 8px 0;
    opacity: 0.4;
  }

  /* Pill tag */
  .pill-tag {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  }

  .pill-tag.elevated {
    background: #FDF0EB;
    color: #C75B2A;
  }

  /* Section text */
  .section-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  .section-main-text {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #2D3748;
    margin-top: 8px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .section-sub-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    margin-top: 4px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* Stats row */
  .stats-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }

  .stat-block {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
  }

  .stat-block + .stat-block::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 6px;
    bottom: 6px;
    width: 0.5px;
    background: #E0E4EC;
  }

  .stat-icon {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .stat-value {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #2D3748;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .stat-value.warn {
    color: #C75B2A;
  }

  .stat-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    margin-top: 2px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3px;
  }

  .stat-label .arrow-down {
    color: #C75B2A;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .stat-label .arrow-up-warn {
    color: #C75B2A;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  /* Life record card */
  .record-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .record-title {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #2D3748;
  }

  .add-btn {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #FDF0EB;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .chip-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 5px 12px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #2D3748;
    background: #F5F6F8;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .chip.warn-chip {
    background: #FDF0EB;
    color: #C75B2A;
  }

  .chip .chip-icon {
    margin-right: 5px;
  }

  .record-sub-section {
    padding-top: 10px;
    border-top: 0.5px solid #ECEEF3;
  }

  .record-sub-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #6B7793;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .record-sub-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .record-sub-text .warn-text {
    color: #C75B2A;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* Action card */
  .action-title {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #2D3748;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .action-desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #6B7793;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .start-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px 0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #2B5EA7;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-align: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .evidence-link {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 14px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #2B5EA7;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding-bottom: 20px;
  }

  /* Tab bar */
  .tab-bar {
    height: 83px;
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-top: 0.5px solid #D8DCE5;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding-top: 8px;
    z-index: 8;
  }

  .tab-item {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .tab-item .tab-icon {
    color: #8A95AD;
  }

  .tab-item.active .tab-icon {
    color: #2B5EA7;
  }

  .tab-item .tab-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .tab-item.active .tab-label {
    color: #2B5EA7;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .home-indicator {
    width: 134px;
    height: 5px;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 9;
  }
</style>
</head>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>方寸 - 今天（数据不足）</title>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: #E8EEF5;
    font-family: -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  .iphone-frame {
    width: 393px;
    height: 852px;
    background: #FAFBFD;
    border-radius: 47px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1a1a1a, 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    color: #2D3748;
  }

  .dynamic-island {
    position: absolute;
    top: 11px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 126px;
    height: 37px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 20px;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  .status-bar {
    height: 54px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 14px 28px 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .status-bar .time { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .status-bar .icons { display: flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center; }

  .screen-content {
    height: calc(852px - 54px - 83px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .screen-content::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .tab-bar {

  .signal-row {

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>方寸 - 今日饮品</title>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: #E8EEF5;
    font-family: -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  .iphone-frame {
    width: 393px;
    height: 852px;
    background: #FAFBFD;
    border-radius: 47px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1a1a1a, 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    color: #2D3748;
  }

  .dynamic-island {
    position: absolute;
    top: 11px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 126px;
    height: 37px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 20px;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  .status-bar {
    height: 54px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 14px 28px 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .status-bar .time { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .status-bar .icons { display: flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center; }

  .screen-content {
    height: calc(852px - 54px - 83px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .screen-content::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .tab-bar {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 83px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-top: 0.5px solid #D8DCE5;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-around;
    padding-top: 8px;
  }
  .tab-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    width: 64px;
  }
  .tab-item.active { color: #2B5EA7; }
  .tab-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

  .home-indicator {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 134px;
    height: 5px;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-radius: 3px;
  }

  /* Top navigation bar */
  .nav-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    padding: 10px 20px 14px;
  }
  .nav-back {
    position: absolute;
    left: 20px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  .nav-back:hover {
    background: #F0F2F7;
  }
  .nav-center {
    text-align: center;
  }
  .nav-title {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #2D3748;
  }
  .nav-subtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  /* Section cards */
  .section-card {
    margin: 10px 20px;
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .section-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 4px;
    border-radius: 14px 0 0 14px;
  }
  .section-card.border-blue::before { background: #2B5EA7; }
  .section-card.border-warm::before { background: #E07B4F; }
  .section-card.border-red::before { background: #C75B2A; }
  .section-card.border-gray::before { background: #8A9AB5; }

  .card-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .card-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .card-icon.blue { background: #E8EFF8; }
  .card-icon.warm { background: #FDF0EB; }
  .card-icon.red { background: #FDEEE8; }
  .card-icon.neutral { background: #F3F5F8; }
  .card-title {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #2D3748;
  }

  /* Water section */
  .water-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .cups-display {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .cup {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .cup.filled {
    background: #2B5EA7;
  }
  .cup.empty {
    background: #EDEFF4;
  }
  .stepper {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1.5px solid #D8DCE5;
  }
  .stepper-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: #FAFBFD;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #2B5EA7;
    border: none;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .stepper-btn:hover {
    background: #E8EFF8;
  }
  .stepper-btn:active {
    background: #D4E0F0;
  }
  .stepper-val {
    width: 36px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #2B5EA7;
    background: #fff;
    border-left: 1px solid #D8DCE5;
    border-right: 1px solid #D8DCE5;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  /* Beverage items */
  .bev-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #F0F2F7;
  }
  .bev-item:last-of-type {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
  .bev-info {
    flex: 1;
  }
  .bev-name {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #2D3748;
  }
  .bev-detail {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }
  .bev-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-left: 8px;
  }
  .bev-action-btn {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
  }
  .bev-action-btn:hover {
    background: #F3F5F8;
  }

  .btn-add-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #2B5EA7;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
  }
  .btn-add-item:hover {
    color: #1E4578;
  }

  /* Empty beverage section */
  .bev-empty {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #8A95AD;
    padding: 6px 0 4px;
  }

  /* Quick-add section */
  .quick-add-section {
    margin: 16px 20px 8px;
  }
  .quick-add-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #6B7793;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .quick-add-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .quick-chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #F0F2F7;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #2D3748;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
  }
  .quick-chip:hover {
    background: #E8EFF8;
    color: #2B5EA7;
  }
  .quick-chip:active {
    background: #D4E0F0;
  }

  /* Bottom note */
  .bottom-note {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 24px 20px;
  }
  .note-text {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #A0A9BC;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .dog-stamp-bottom {
    opacity: 0.3;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-left: 8px;
  }

  /* Paper texture */
  .section-card::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0.015;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='200' height='200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='200' height='200' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='1'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    background-size: 200px 200px;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="iphone-frame">
  <div class="dynamic-island"></div>
  <div class="status-bar">
    <span class="time">9:41</span>
    <div class="icons">
      <svg width="17" height="12" viewBox="0 0 17 12" fill="none"><rect x="0" y="3" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#2D3748"/><rect x="4.5" y="2" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#2D3748"/><rect x="9" y="1" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#2D3748"/><rect x="13.5" y="0" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#2D3748"/></svg>
      <svg width="16" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 12" fill="none"><path d="M8 3.6C10.2 3.6 12.1 4.5 13.5 6L15 4.5C13.2 2.6 10.7 1.5 8 1.5S2.8 2.6 1 4.5L2.5 6C3.9 4.5 5.8 3.6 8 3.6Z" fill="#2D3748"/><path d="M8 7.2C9.3 7.2 10.5 7.7 11.3 8.6L8 12L4.7 8.6C5.5 7.7 6.7 7.2 8 7.2Z" fill="#2D3748"/></svg>
      <svg width="25" height="12" viewBox="0 0 25 12" fill="none"><rect x="0" y="1" width="22" height="10" rx="2" stroke="#2D3748" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/><rect x="22.5" y="4" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#2D3748"/><rect x="1.5" y="2.5" width="18" height="7" rx="1" fill="#2D3748"/></svg>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="screen-content">

    <!-- Top navigation -->
    <div class="nav-bar">
      <div class="nav-back">
        <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none">
          <path d="M14 4L7 11L14 18" stroke="#2B5EA7" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="nav-center">
        <div class="nav-title">今日饮品</div>
        <div class="nav-subtitle">9月17日</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Section 1: Water -->
    <div class="section-card border-blue">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-icon blue">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
            <path d="M8 2C8 2 3.5 7.5 3.5 10.5C3.5 13 5.5 14.5 8 14.5C10.5 14.5 12.5 13 12.5 10.5C12.5 7.5 8 2 8 2Z" fill="#94B3D7" opacity="0.3" stroke="#2B5EA7" stroke-width="1.2"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <span class="card-title">饮水</span>
      </div>
      <div class="water-row">
        <div class="cups-display">
          <div class="cup filled">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="white"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="cup filled">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="white"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="cup filled">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="white"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="cup filled">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="white"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="cup empty">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="#C8CDD8"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="cup empty">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="#C8CDD8"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="cup empty">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="#C8CDD8"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="cup empty">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
              <path d="M7 2C7 2 3.5 5.8 3.5 8C3.5 10 5 11.5 7 11.5C9 11.5 10.5 10 10.5 8C10.5 5.8 7 2 7 2Z" fill="#C8CDD8"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="stepper">
          <button class="stepper-btn">−</button>
          <div class="stepper-val">4</div>
          <button class="stepper-btn">+</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Section 2: Caffeine -->
    <div class="section-card border-warm">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-icon warm">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
            <rect x="2.5" y="5" width="9" height="8" rx="1.5" stroke="#E07B4F" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
            <path d="M11.5 7H13C13.8 7 14.5 7.7 14.5 8.5C14.5 9.3 13.8 10 13 10H11.5" stroke="#E07B4F" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
            <path d="M5.5 3.5C5.5 3.5 5.8 2 7 2C8.2 2 8.5 3.5 8.5 3.5" stroke="#E07B4F" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <line x1="7" y1="2.5" x2="7" y2="4.5" stroke="#E07B4F" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

            </svg>
          </button>
          <button class="bev-action-btn">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
              <path d="M3 4.5H13M6 4.5V3C6 2.4 6.4 2 7 2H9C9.6 2 10 2.4 10 3V4.5M5 4.5V13C5 13.6 5.4 14 6 14H10C10.6 14 11 13.6 11 13V4.5" stroke="#8A95AD" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-add-item">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
          <circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5.5" stroke="#2B5EA7" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M7 4.5V9.5M4.5 7H9.5" stroke="#2B5EA7" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </svg>
        添加咖啡因饮品
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Section 3: Alcohol -->
    <div class="section-card border-red">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-icon red">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
            <path d="M5 2L4 8C4 10.2 5.8 12 8 12C10.2 12 12 10.2 12 8L11 2H5Z" stroke="#C75B2A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
            <line x1="8" y1="12" x2="8" y2="14.5" stroke="#C75B2A" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <line x1="5.5" y1="14.5" x2="10.5" y2="14.5" stroke="#C75B2A" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <path d="M5.5 6H10.5" stroke="#C75B2A" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.5"/>

        <span class="card-title">酒精</span>

      <div class="bev-item">
        <div class="bev-info">
          <div class="bev-name">啤酒 ×1</div>

        <div class="bev-actions">
          <button class="bev-action-btn">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">

            </svg>
          </button>
          <button class="bev-action-btn">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
              <path d="M3 4.5H13M6 4.5V3C6 2.4 6.4 2 7 2H9C9.6 2 10 2.4 10 3V4.5M5 4.5V13C5 13.6 5.4 14 6 14H10C10.6 14 11 13.6 11 13V4.5" stroke="#8A95AD" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            </svg>

        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-add-item">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
          <circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5.5" stroke="#2B5EA7" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M7 4.5V9.5M4.5 7H9.5" stroke="#2B5EA7" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </svg>
        添加酒精饮品
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Section 4: Sugary drinks -->
    <div class="section-card border-gray">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-icon neutral">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
            <path d="M5 3H11L10.5 13C10.5 13.3 10.2 13.5 10 13.5H6C5.8 13.5 5.5 13.3 5.5 13L5 3Z" stroke="#8A9AB5" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
            <path d="M4 3H12" stroke="#8A9AB5" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <circle cx="7.5" cy="8" r="0.8" fill="#8A9AB5" opacity="0.4"/>
            <circle cx="9" cy="10" r="0.6" fill="#8A9AB5" opacity="0.4"/>
            <circle cx="7" cy="10.5" r="0.5" fill="#8A9AB5" opacity="0.4"/>

        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
          <circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5.5" stroke="#2B5EA7" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>

        </svg>
        添加

    <!-- Quick-add section -->
    <div class="quick-add-section">
      <div class="quick-add-label">快速添加</div>
      <div class="quick-add-row">
        <button class="quick-chip">
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" style="margin-right:4px;">
            <path d="M6 1C6 1 2.5 5 2.5 7.5C2.5 9.4 4 11 6 11C8 11 9.5 9.4 9.5 7.5C9.5 5 6 1 6 1Z" fill="#94B3D7" opacity="0.5"/>
          </svg>
          水
        </button>
        <button class="quick-chip">美式</button>
        <button class="quick-chip">拿铁</button>
        <button class="quick-chip">绿茶</button>
        <button class="quick-chip">啤酒</button>
        <button class="quick-chip">红酒</button>
        <button class="quick-chip">可乐</button>
        <button class="quick-chip">奶茶</button>
        <button class="quick-chip">果汁</button>

    </div>

    <!-- Bottom note with dog stamp -->
    <div class="bottom-note">
      <div class="note-text">一杯饮品可能同时计入多个类别</div>
      <div class="dog-stamp-bottom">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," width="36" height="36" style="object-fit:contain" alt="猫">
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div class="tab-bar">
    <div class="tab-item">
      <div class="tab-icon"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none"><path d="M3 9.5L11 3L19 9.5V18C19 18.6 18.6 19 18 19H4C3.4 19 3 18.6 3 18V9.5Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/><rect x="8" y="13" width="6" height="6" rx="1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/></svg></div>
      <span>今天</span>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-item">
      <div class="tab-icon"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/><path d="M11 7V11.5L14 14" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>
      <span>练习</span>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-item active">
      <div class="tab-icon"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none"><path d="M4 17V8M8 17V5M12 17V10M16 17V7M20 17V12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>
      <span>记录</span>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-item">
      <div class="tab-icon"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none"><circle cx="11" cy="5" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="11" cy="17" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/></svg></div>
      <span>更多</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="home-indicator"></div>
</div>
</body>
</html>
